    Non-production MongoDB configuration, backed by an embedded in-memory MongoDB instance, similar to how H2 is used as an in-memory SQL database for these profiles.

    ResolveHostnameJob
    Attempts a reverse DNS lookup for one IP address, updating HostTrackingService with the result (the resolved hostname, or the address itself if resolution fails).
    ResolveHostnameJobFactory
    Builds and launches a ResolveHostnameJob for one IP address.
    RoleUpdateInterceptor
    Reloads a user's security context on each request so that role changes (admin/hostManager added or removed in the database) take effect without requiring re-login.
